171	
172	**Gateway deployment shape** (the api.md handoff): the token-authed
173	trustless gateway is Caddy in front of Kubo's gateway port —
174	`forward_auth` to a lightweight API token-verification endpoint, then
175	proxy to Kubo for block/CAR responses. The API process serves no bytes;
176	Caddy enforces membership; Kubo serves. Token format and TTL are API
177	build-time detail. Public trustless gateways remain the no-auth fallback,
178	so this path can fail without breaking reads.
179	
180	**Web hosting**: Caddy keeps serving the static bundle from
181	`/opt/cipherbox/web` — but the artifact deployed is the production build
182	the e2e suite tested (testing.md: the artifact that ships is the artifact
183	tested). **PWA install surface** (the web-client.md handoff): v2.0 ships a
184	valid manifest and the decided SW app-shell precache, but does **not**
185	advertise installability — no install-prompt UX. Browser-menu install
186	works for those who seek it; install promotion is a post-v2.0 decision.
187	
188	**Observability**: alloy → Grafana Cloud and the dashboard-provisioning
189	job port; the dashboards themselves are rewritten during the build (TEE
190	panels die, republisher inventory-walk and re-PUT metrics arrive; the
191	Kubo-version metrics caveat re-checked on the Kubo bump). Faro RUM in the
192	web build carries over.
193	
194	**Landing page**: `deploy-landing.yml` and the Render preview path are
195	outside the v2 blast radius and port untouched, except fixing the known
196	env-name mismatch (`secrets.DNSLINK_RECORD_ID` vs the
197	`CLOUDFLARE_DNSLINK_RECORD_ID` variable, and the missing `environment:`
198	binding).
199	
200	### Cutover
201	
202	One scheduled, announced, destructive redeploy: stop the v1 stack, remove
203	the `postgres` and `ipfs` volumes, deploy the v2 stack fresh. No data
204	migration, no dual-running (#6 — v1 is staging-only, all-DEVNET). Staging
205	URL and Web3Auth config decisions carry per #6 (free to keep or change on
206	merit). One accepted consequence, stated: existing v1 desktop installs
207	auto-update into v2 via `/releases/latest` and their local vaults become
208	orphans — consistent with the clean break; the v2 first-run treats them as
209	new devices.
210	
211	## CI infrastructure
212	
213	### Runners
214	
215	GitHub-hosted only; no self-hosted runners in v2.0.
216	
217	- **PR gate**: `ubuntu-latest` for everything except the Windows adapter
218	  check (`windows-latest`). The browser suite (Playwright/chromium) and the
219	  contract-suite stack (Postgres + Kubo + mock routing store as GH
220	  services) both fit ubuntu. The PR e2e smoke slice runs on ubuntu only.
221	- **Main gate**: the mounted-desktop matrix keeps v1's three runner
222	  provisions — `macos-latest` + FUSE-T, `windows-latest` + pinned WinFsp
223	  MSI, `ubuntu-latest` + libfuse3/Xvfb. **Cross-client e2e rides the same
224	  matrix runners**: each OS leg runs the built web artifact headless
225	  alongside the mounted desktop against one stack — no fourth runner
226	  class, and cross-client gets per-OS coverage for free.
227	- **Toolchain single-sourcing** (fixes a v1 defect): a root
228	  `rust-toolchain.toml` becomes the one Rust pin — every job's
229	  `rustup default stable` line is deleted so CI builds what the repo pins.
230	  Node pins once in root `package.json` (`engines` + the existing
231	  `packageManager`), and workflows read it via `node-version-file` instead
232	  of sixteen hard-coded `'22'` strings. Dockerfiles align to the same
233	  major (the tee-worker `node:20` straggler dies with the app).
234	
235	### Caching and hygiene
236	
237	The v1 strategy ports: `setup-node` pnpm cache keyed on the lockfile;
238	`actions/cache` on cargo registry/git/target keyed per-OS on `Cargo.lock`.
239	The WASM build (`crates/wasm`, wasm-pack/wasm-bindgen) joins the cargo
240	cache key-space; `cargo-llvm-cov` and other cargo-installed tools move to a
241	cached install instead of v1's cold `cargo install` per run. Codecov ports
242	demoted to informational (testing.md): the upload jobs and
243	`codecov-base.yml` stay, thresholds stop gating. `zizmor.yml` and the
244	SHA-pinned-actions convention port as-is and apply to every edited
245	workflow.
246	
247	### Scheduled tier
248	
249	One new `nightly.yml` (cron) owns the scheduled slots testing.md defined:
250	
251	- **Long-horizon liveness**: the compressed-EOL profile run — lease
252	  renewal at seq+1, the republisher inventory walk, >24 h-no-re-PUT
253	  alerting — nightly against the CI stack.
254	- **Full-matrix flake surveillance**: the main-gate e2e matrix re-run on
255	  `main` HEAD nightly. With `retries: 0` as policy, this distinguishes
256	  "main broke" (revert) from "environment drifted" (fix the harness)
257	  before it blocks a release.
258	
259	Dispatch-only (unscheduled): the load harness against local or staging
260	(`load-test.yml` ports with its BYO scenarios), and the real Web3Auth
261	Core Kit login job against staging with the test credentials — the honest
262	inherited limitation testing.md records; never a PR gate.
263	
264	## Disposition of the v1 inventory
265	
266	Workflows (all edited in place, per #28 D7):
267	
268	| v1 workflow                                                                            | Disposition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
269	| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
270	| `ci.yml`                                                                               | **Restructured** — skeleton, dorny path filters, service-container pattern, failure-artifact uploads port; jobs become the testing.md PR gate (lint/typecheck, cargo workspace + KAT/WASM, browser suite, contract suite, Windows adapter, migration drift, e2e smoke). `api-spec`, `vector-parity`, and the grep gates die (table above) |
271	| `ci-e2e.yml`                                                                           | **Ports** — the main-gate orchestrator (full web + desktop mounted + cross-client); `retrigger-release-gate` dies                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
272	| `web-e2e.yml`, `desktop-e2e.yml`                                                       | **Port** — reusable shape and per-OS provisioning intact; suites rewired per testing.md; desktop legs gain the cross-client run                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
273	| `release-please.yml`                                                                   | **Ports simplified** — single component, app-token mechanism kept; un-latest loop and lock-sync fallback deleted                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
274	| `pr-release-preview.yml` (+ script), `release-gate.yml`, `cargo-lock-release-sync.yml` | **Die** (doctrine table)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
275	| `tag-staging.yml`                                                                      | **Ports** — single `v*` assertion, adds cross-client to the gate, same `staging-approval` + tag mint                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
276	| `deploy-staging.yml`                                                                   | **Edited** — `build-tee` and redis plumbing out, gateway `forward_auth` wiring and volume-wipe cutover support in; VPS mechanics unchanged                                                                                                                                                                                                |
277	| `desktop-staging-release.yml`                                                          | **Becomes `desktop-release.yml`** — triggers on `v*`, attaches to the release-please release, `mark-latest` dies                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
278	| `deploy-landing.yml`                                                                   | **Ports** — env-name mismatch fixed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
279	| `load-test.yml`                                                                        | **Ports** — dispatch-only                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
280	| `pr-title.yml`, `zizmor.yml`, `codecov-base.yml`                                       | **Port as-is**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
281	
282	Docker, scripts, hooks:
283	
284	| v1 artifact                                                                                                 | Disposition                                                                                                                |
285	| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
286	| `docker/docker-compose.yml` (local dev)                                                                     | **Edited** — postgres/kubo/someguy/mock-ipns-routing stay; redis and tee-worker leave; the 6380/6379 redis port split dies |
287	| `docker/docker-compose.staging.yml`, `Caddyfile`, `alloy-config.river`, `ipfs-init/`                        | **Edited** per the stack table                                                                                             |
288	| `apps/tee-worker/Dockerfile`, `docker-compose{,.phala}.yml`                                                 | **Die**                                                                                                                    |
289	| `apps/api/Dockerfile`                                                                                       | **Edited** — build graph becomes crates + api                                                                              |
290	| `tools/mock-ipns-routing/Dockerfile`                                                                        | **Ports** — the promoted CI routing store (testing.md)                                                                     |
291	| `scripts/check-api-client.sh`, `check-vector-parity.sh`, vector/bench generators, `backfill-pinned-cids.ts` | **Die** (gates replaced; one-shots done)                                                                                   |
292	| `scripts/baseline-benchmark.sh`                                                                             | **Ports** — ops tooling                                                                                                    |
293	| `.husky/pre-commit`                                                                                         | **Edited** — lint-staged stays, the api-client staging check dies; the Entire wrapper hooks are untouched                  |
294	
295	Secrets and environments (repo settings reused as-is per D7; retirements at
296	cutover):
297	
298	| Item                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Disposition                                                                                                                                |
299	| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
300	| `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY(_PASSWORD)`, `IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY`, `STAGING_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET`, `STAGING_THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET`, `STAGING_SSH_KEY`, `STAGING_DB_PASSWORD`, `STAGING_JWT_SECRET`, `WEB3AUTH_TEST_EMAIL/OTP`, `VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID`, `RELEASE_BOT_*`, `CODECOV_TOKEN`, Grafana/Faro/Cloudflare families, `PINATA_JWT` (BYO load scenarios) | **Keep**                                                                                                                                   |
301	| `STAGING_TEE_WORKER_SECRET`, `PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY`, `PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL`, `STAGING_REDIS_PASSWORD`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | **Retire at cutover** — TEE and redis are gone                                                                                             |
302	| `SENDGRID_API_KEY`, `SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | **Retire** — the v2 API has no email surface (invites are bearer links, notifications ride the mailbox)                                    |
303	| `staging`, `staging-approval` environments                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | **Keep** — same roles                                                                                                                      |
304	| `production` environment                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | **Stays parked** — production remains funding-gated; its topology (same compose stack + CDN'd static web) is designed-for, not provisioned |
305	
306	## Open edges
307	
308	- **Cutover trigger** — the criteria for scheduling the destructive
309	  redeploy (v2 contract suite + smoke green on a VPS dry-run); build-time
310	  judgment, announced in advance.
311	- **Gateway token detail** — format, TTL, and the verify endpoint's shape
312	  behind Caddy `forward_auth`; API build-time work within the shape fixed
313	  above.
314	- **Dashboard rewrite** — the v2 Grafana dashboard set (republisher walk,
315	  mailbox depth, gateway auth hit-rate) lands with the metrics that feed
316	  it.
317	- **Nightly cost tuning** — the full-matrix surveillance run is the
318	  expensive slot; trim to a rotation if runner spend becomes real money.
319	- **Production go-live** — out of scope until funded: provisioning the
320	  parked environment, a second VPS or managed Postgres, CDN for the web
321	  bundle, and DNS cutover would each be decisions then, on this doc's
322	  seams.

196	
197	Path-filtered like v1 (the dorny pattern and reusable-workflow structure
198	port), reorganized into three tiers:
199	
200	| Tier                         | Trigger        | Contents                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
201	| ---------------------------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
202	| **PR gate** — merge-blocking | every PR       | lint + typecheck; cargo workspace tests (core KATs + property layer, engine simulation, fuse op core); the WASM KAT run; the `packages/client` browser suite; the contract suite on the CI stack; Windows cargo check + adapter tests; DB migration drift check (ports as-is if the API keeps TypeORM); an e2e **smoke slice** — a bounded-minutes budget of web login-and-CRUD plus one timing-profile cross-client scenario |
203	| **Main gate**                | push to main   | the full web-e2e suite, the desktop mounted matrix (macOS/Linux/Windows), the full cross-client matrix. Failure is treated revert-first, not fix-forward — this tier exists to bound the blast radius of what the smoke slice missed, never to be the first line                                                                                                                                                              |
204	| **Dispatch / scheduled**     | manual or cron | the load harness (v1's k6 scenarios in `tests/load/` port); long-horizon liveness — lease renewal at seq+1 and the republisher walk against a compressed-EOL profile; staging release gates (mechanics → [#48](https://github.com/FSM1/cipher-box-next/issues/48))                                                                                                                                                            |
205	
206	The CI stack: Postgres, Kubo, the API under test, and a local `/routing/v1`
207	record store — v1's `mock-ipns-routing` tool **promoted, not deleted**: a
208	dumb delegated-routing server is exactly the RecordTransport seam's shape,
209	so the hermetic CI store and production someguy are interchangeable behind
210	the same client code. someguy itself runs in staging, not CI (the real DHT
211	has no place in a hermetic gate). The v1 redis/tee-worker services leave the
212	stack; the local/CI redis port split (6380/6379) dies with them.
213	
214	## The DX hook — the environment-scoped timing profile
215	
216	The sync timing profile (#33 D3) is the single lever that makes v2's
217	cross-client flows testable at speed, and this doc is its consumer contract:
218	
219	- **CI profile**: record TTL 1–5 s (small but nonzero — `0`/unset is how v1
220	  fell into a silent 5-minute default), compressed poll cadence, staleness
221	  thresholds, escalation window, pointer-consult interval, and a small
222	  staging budget so budget-exhaustion paths are reachable. Production
223	  profile: TTL 1 minute, 30 s poll, per #33.
224	- **Nocache manual refresh** is the TTL-independent forcing path — the
225	  deterministic sync barrier between clients in every cross-client scenario.
226	- **No sleeps anywhere**: web polls the introspection hook, desktop polls
227	  the filesystem and tray state, both bounded by profile-derived timeouts.
228	- **The profile is where measured constants land.** The open-edge numbers
229	  the sibling docs handed here — the migration-window closure constant, the
230	  sweep cadence, kernel entry/attr TTLs per backend, chunk size and DAG
231	  shape — get their values from measurements this harness produces (the
232	  cross-client latency measurement job, the FUSE-T invalidation round-trip,
233	  ranged-fetch profiles). Each lands as a profile-constant change with its
234	  measurement linked. The process is fixed here; the values are build-time
235	  work.
236

238	
239	The #32 pre-build checks, owned here as task-shaped verifications with
240	recorded results — they precede `crates/fuse` work, and they are not CI:
241	
242	1. FUSE-T ≥ 1.2.7 SMB invalidation round-trip, with measured cross-client
243	   latency — feeds the kernel TTL constants above.
244	2. Replay of the v1 macOS cross-client flake scenario against the SMB
245	   backend.
246	3. Overwrite-rename atomicity under the SMB backend.
247	4. FUSE-T commercial license terms for bundling.
248	5. The FSKit spike against the macOS 27 beta

253	
254	## Coverage policy
255	
256	No blanket line-coverage thresholds as merge gates. v1's record: the

input.prompt:
Work in /Users/myankelev/Code/random/cipher-box (branch chore/v2-workspace-scaffold — already checked out; do NOT create branches, do NOT commit, do NOT push, do NOT touch .github/, docker/, package.json, or any *.md). The v1 cargo workspace was just deleted. Scaffold the v2 cargo workspace skeleton.

Context: this is the CipherBox v2 rewrite. The normative design docs are blueprint/core.md (crates/core — wire formats, crypto), blueprint/engine.md (crates/engine — the one stateful engine), blueprint/web-client.md (crates/wasm — wasm-bindgen bindings over engine), blueprint/desktop.md (crates/fuse — FS projection core). You are creating EMPTY SKELETON crates only — no domain logic, no crypto, no dependencies beyond the internal path deps. Real code lands in later PRs.

Create exactly:

1. Root `Cargo.toml`:
   - `[workspace]` resolver = "3", members = ["crates/core", "crates/engine", "crates/wasm", "crates/fuse"]
   - `[workspace.package]`: version = "0.0.0" (crates are version-frozen, never published — normative from blueprint/deploy.md), edition = "2024", license = "MIT", repository = "https://github.com/FSM1/cipher-box", rust-version = "1.88", publish = false
   - `[workspace.dependencies]`: only the internal path deps: cipherbox-core = { path = "crates/core" }, cipherbox-engine = { path = "crates/engine" }
   - A short header comment noting crates are unpublished implementation detail version-frozen at 0.0.0 per blueprint/deploy.md.

2. Four crates, package names cipherbox-core, cipherbox-engine, cipherbox-wasm, cipherbox-fuse in crates/{core,engine,wasm,fuse}. Each Cargo.toml inherits everything inheritable from workspace (version.workspace = true, edition.workspace = true, license.workspace = true, repository.workspace = true, rust-version.workspace = true, publish.workspace = true). Dependency DAG: engine depends on cipherbox-core (workspace dep); wasm depends on cipherbox-engine; fuse depends on cipherbox-engine. core has no deps.

3. Each src/lib.rs: a `//!` crate-level doc comment (2-4 lines) stating what the crate will be and pointing at its blueprint doc (e.g. "Normative design: blueprint/core.md"). Add `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` to core and engine only (wasm/fuse will need FFI later). Give each crate one tiny honest placeholder item so the crate and its tests are non-vacuous — e.g. `pub const CRATE: &str = "cipherbox-core";` plus a unit test asserting it; in engine/wasm/fuse the test should also reference the upstream crate's item (e.g. assert cipherbox_core::CRATE == "cipherbox-core") so the dependency edge is exercised. No other code.

4. The root rust-toolchain.toml already pins channel 1.88 — do not modify it.

Then verify — all three MUST pass and you must run them for real:
- cargo fmt --all --check
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
- cargo test --workspace
This generates the new Cargo.lock — leave it in place.

If rustup lacks 1.88 locally, install that toolchain rather than changing the pin. Return: the file list you created, and the last ~5 lines of each verification command's real output.

input.content:
# v2 PR gate (blueprint/testing.md). Day-one jobs cover what exists: the
# stub cargo workspace and the TS workspace stubs. The remaining PR-gate
# suites (WASM KAT run, packages/client browser suite, contract suite,
# Windows adapter tests, migration drift, e2e smoke slice) land with their
# code and must block merges in a named job the day they land (law 1).
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      ts: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.ts }}
      rust: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.rust }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@7b450fff21473bca461d4b92ce414b9d0420d706 # v4.0.2
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            ts:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'package.json'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'
            rust:
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'rust-toolchain.toml'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@0ebf47130e4866e96fce0953f49152a61190b271 # v6.0.9

      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: 'package.json'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.ts == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@0ebf47130e4866e96fce0953f49152a61190b271 # v6.0.9

      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: 'package.json'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.ts == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@0ebf47130e4866e96fce0953f49152a61190b271 # v6.0.9

      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: 'package.json'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pnpm test

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.ts == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@0ebf47130e4866e96fce0953f49152a61190b271 # v6.0.9

      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: 'package.json'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm build

  cargo-linux:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --all --check

      - name: Cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace

  cargo-macos:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace

  cargo-windows:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace

# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

CipherBox releases as a single product version (`vX.Y.Z`). The repo is
mid-rewrite: **no supported release currently exists**. v1 is frozen on the
`v1` branch (tag `v1-freeze`), was staging-only, and receives no fixes; v2 is
being built on `main` and starts releasing at `v2.0.0`. From then on, only
the latest release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Use [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/FSM1/cipher-box/security/advisories/new)
to submit a report confidentially.

Include as much of the following as is available:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof-of-concept (even partial)
- Affected component(s) and version(s)
- Any suggested mitigations

**Response expectations** (best-effort targets, not contractual commitments):

- Acknowledgement within 5 business days
- Initial triage and severity assessment within 10 business days
- Coordinated disclosure after a fix is available or 90 days from report, whichever comes first

## Security Model and Scope

CipherBox is an end-to-end encrypted storage system. A brief summary of the v2 threat model:

- **Client-side encryption only.** Files and metadata are encrypted on the client before leaving
  the device. The server stores and relays only ciphertext.
- **Zero-knowledge server.** The API never receives plaintext file contents, file names, or
  unencrypted keys, and never serves IPNS records — clients resolve and verify records against
  the network.
- **One crypto implementation.** All cryptography lives in `crates/core`: XChaCha20-Poly1305
  sealing, BLAKE3 tree KDF, X25519 + HPKE key wrapping, REDACTED signing. Key
  derivation is restricted to a frozen KDF catalog.
- **Fail-closed verification.** Every resolved record must pass the adoption gate (signature,
  epoch, and structure checks); a failure is treated as a trust violation, never as staleness.
- **Keyless republishing.** IPNS records are re-published by a keyless module inside the API
  from client-signed records — the server never holds signing keys.

For the full design, see [`blueprint/core.md`](blueprint/core.md) (primitives, wire formats)
and [`blueprint/engine.md`](blueprint/engine.md) (trust model).

### In scope

- Vulnerabilities that could expose plaintext user data or private keys
- Authentication or authorization bypasses in the API
- Cryptographic weaknesses in key derivation, wrapping, sealing, or signing
- Adoption-gate bypasses (accepting a record that should fail verification)
- Vulnerabilities in the desktop app (FUSE layer, IPC, OAuth redirect handling)

### Out of scope

- Denial-of-service attacks against public infrastructure
- Social engineering of maintainers
- Vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies (report those upstream; mention them here if they affect CipherBox directly)
- The frozen v1 branch
- Issues in deferred features (billing, mobile apps) that are not implemented

Step 2 of the v2 kickoff: `main` becomes the v2 workspace. Executes the layout demolition and D3 skeleton per `blueprint/deploy.md` freeze mechanics (step 3) and the disposition tables.

## Changes

1. **Demolish the v1 layout** — all v1 apps, packages, crates, test suites, dead scripts, and the v1 cargo workspace are removed (1,271 files). Everything remains on the `v1` branch (tag `v1-freeze`). `scripts/baseline-benchmark.sh` and `tools/mock-ipns-routing` (the promoted CI routing store) survive per disposition.
2. **Scaffold the v2 workspace skeleton** — compiling stubs only, filled in slice by slice against the blueprints:
   - Cargo workspace `cipherbox-{core,engine,wasm,fuse}`: version-frozen at 0.0.0 (`workspace.package`, `publish = false`), edition 2024, rust 1.88, dependency DAG wired (engine→core, wasm→engine, fuse→engine) and exercised by unit tests. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` on core and engine.
   - pnpm workspace: `packages/client` (stub + vitest), `apps/api` (NestJS health endpoint, unit-tested and smoke-tested live: `GET /health` → 200 `{"status":"ok"}`), `apps/web` (Vite + React 19 shell).
   - `apps/desktop` and `tests/` land with their build phases (release-please stays dormant until the desktop version surface exists).
3. **Restructure CI to the day-one v2 PR gate** — `ci.yml` gates what exists: Lint, Typecheck, Test, Build, Cargo Check & Test on Linux/macOS/Windows. Dead jobs die per the doctrine table: api-spec, SDK E2E, migration drift, vector-parity, and the grep gates. Remaining testing.md PR-gate suites (WASM KAT run, browser suite, contract suite, e2e smoke) must land as named blocking jobs with their code (law 1).
4. **Dormancy for suite-dependent workflows** — `ci-e2e.yml` goes dispatch-only (it fired on every main push and would go red against the demolished suites); `web-e2e`, `desktop-e2e`, `load-test`, `desktop-staging-release` carry dormancy headers. `deploy-staging.yml` drops the tee-worker image build, redis, and SendGrid plumbing (full gateway/forward_auth edit lands with the cutover).
5. **Config alignment** — local docker compose drops redis + tee-worker (validated with `docker compose config`); codecov becomes informational-only per the coverage policy; CodeRabbit path instructions swap dead `packages/crypto` for `crates/**` with v2 crypto guidance; `.github/copilot-instructions.md` now points at `AGENTS.md`; SECURITY.md rewritten for the v2 model (one-version support, adoption-gate scope, no TEE).
